youtube.title: Kaun accept, kaun reject, aur kyun? Admit Finder dekho
youtube.description:
Admission luck nahi, pattern hai. EduAbroad Admit Finder pe real students ke accepted aur rejected dono profiles hain, GPA, GRE, IELTS ya TOEFL aur work experience ke saath. Ek profile mein IELTS 9 tha, phir bhi reject. Score sab kuch nahi. Free hai, login ki zaroorat nahi.

👉 https://app.goeduabroad.com/admit-finder

EduAbroad: Run by Harvard-Cambridge Alumni. 100% private. Contact aap karoge, hum nahi.
